text_en: In the twenty-seventh year of King Jeroboam of Israel King Azariah son of Amaziah of Judah began to reign.
text_cn: 以色列王雅洛贝罕二十七年，阿玛责雅的儿子阿匝黎雅登极为犹大王。

text_en: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 他登极时十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王凡五十二年；他母亲名叫耶苛里雅，是耶路撒冷人。

text_en: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.
text_cn: 阿匝黎雅行了上主视为正义的事，完全像他父亲阿玛责雅所行的一样，

text_en: Nevertheless the high places were not taken away; the people still sacrificed and made offerings on the high places.
text_cn: 只是高丘仍没有废除，人民仍在高丘上焚香献祭。

text_en: The Lord struck the king, so that he was leprous to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham the king’s son was in charge of the palace, governing the people of the land.
text_cn: 上主打击了君王，君王即患了癞病，直到他死的那一天，独自住在一所王宫里。那时，君王的儿子约堂代理朝事，统治国家的百姓。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?
text_cn: 阿匝黎雅其余的事迹，他行的一切，都记载在《犹大列王实录》上。

text_en: Azariah slept with his ancestors; they buried him with his ancestors in the city of David; his son Jotham succeeded him.
text_cn: 阿匝黎雅与祖先同眠，与祖先同葬在达味城；他的儿子约堂继位为王。

text_en: In the thirty-eighth year of King Azariah of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.
text_cn: 犹大王阿匝黎雅三十八年，雅洛贝罕的儿子则加黎雅在撒玛黎雅登极为以色列王，在位六个月；

text_en: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , as his ancestors had done. He did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he caused Israel to sin.
text_cn: 他行了上主视为恶的事，像他的祖先所行的一样，没有离开乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕，使以色列陷于罪恶的罪。

text_en: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him down in public and killed him, and reigned in place of him.
text_cn: 雅贝士的儿子沙隆结党反叛他，在依贝肋罕杀了他，篡位为王。

text_en: Now the rest of the deeds of Zechariah are written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
text_cn: 则加黎雅其余的事迹都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: This was the promise of the Lord that he gave to Jehu, “Your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation. ” And so it happened.
text_cn: 这正应验了上主对耶胡所说的话：“你的子孙要坐以色列王位，直到第四代。”

text_en: Shallum son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of King Uzziah of Judah; he reigned one month in Samaria.
text_cn: 犹大王乌齐雅三十九年，雅贝士的儿子沙隆登极为王，在撒玛黎雅作王一个月。

text_en: Then Menahem son of Gadi came up from Tirzah and came to Samaria; he struck down Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria and killed him; he reigned in place of him.
text_cn: 那时，加狄的儿子默纳恒从提尔匝来到撒玛黎雅，在撒玛黎雅杀了雅贝士的儿子沙隆，篡位为王。

text_en: Now the rest of the deeds of Shallum, including the conspiracy that he made, are written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
text_cn: 沙隆其余的事迹，和他如何结党谋反，都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: At that time Menahem sacked Tiphsah, all who were in it and its territory from Tirzah on; because they did not open it to him, he sacked it. He ripped open all the pregnant women in it.
text_cn: 以后默纳恒从提尔匝出发攻打塔普亚，又攻打其四境，因为人没有给他开城门，所以攻破以后，屠杀了城中所有的人，剖开了所有的孕妇。

text_en: In the thirty-ninth year of King Azariah of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi began to reign over Israel; he reigned ten years in Samaria.
text_cn: 犹大王阿匝黎雅三十九年，加狄的儿子默纳恒登极为以色列王，在撒玛黎雅作王十年，

text_en: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord ; he did not depart all his days from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he caused Israel to sin.
text_cn: 行了上主视为恶的事，在他有生之日，始终没有离开乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕，使以色列陷于罪恶的罪。

text_en: King Pul of Assyria came against the land; Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, so that he might help him confirm his hold on the royal power.
text_cn: 那时，亚述王普耳前来犯境，默纳恒就送给了普耳一千"塔冷通"银子，要求他扶持自己，巩固自己的王权。

text_en: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, that is, from all the wealthy, fifty shekels of silver from each one, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and did not stay there in the land.
text_cn: 默纳恒向以色列所有富豪征收银子，每人应缴纳五十"协刻耳"，为进献给亚述王。亚述王于是回去了，没有在境内停留。

text_en: Now the rest of the deeds of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?
text_cn: 默纳恒其余的事迹，他行的一切，都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: Menahem slept with his ancestors, and his son Pekahiah succeeded him.
text_cn: 默纳恒与祖先同眠后，他的儿子培卡希雅继位为王。

text_en: In the fiftieth year of King Azariah of Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria; he reigned two years.
text_cn: 犹大王阿匝黎雅五十年，默纳恒的儿子培卡希雅登极为以色列王，在撒玛黎雅作王两年。

text_en: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord ; he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he caused Israel to sin.
text_cn: 他行了上主视为恶的事，没有离开乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕，使以色列陷于罪恶的种种罪恶。

text_en: Pekah son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him with fifty of the Gileadites, and attacked him in Samaria, in the citadel of the palace along with Argob and Arieh; he killed him, and reigned in place of him.
text_cn: 他的军官，勒玛里雅的儿子培卡黑结党反叛他，同阿尔哥布和阿黎厄，以及与他同谋的五十个基肋阿得人，在撒玛黎雅王宫的堡垒内，将他杀死，篡位为王。

text_en: Now the rest of the deeds of Pekahiah, and all that he did, are written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
text_cn: 培卡希雅其余的事迹，他行的一切，都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: In the fifty-second year of King Azariah of Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria; he reigned twenty years.
text_cn: 犹大王阿匝黎雅五十二年，勒玛里雅的儿子培卡黑登极为以色列王，在撒玛黎雅作王凡二十年。

text_en: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord ; he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he caused Israel to sin.
text_cn: 他行了上主视为恶的事，没有离开乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕，使以色列陷于罪恶的种种罪恶。

text_en: In the days of King Pekah of Israel, King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria came and captured Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried the people captive to Assyria.
text_cn: 以色列王培卡黑在位时，亚述王提革拉特丕肋色尔前来，侵占了依雍、阿贝耳贝特玛阿加、雅诺亚、刻德士、哈祚尔、基肋阿得、加里肋亚和纳斐塔里全地；并将这些地方的居民都掳往亚述。

text_en: Then Hoshea son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah son of Remaliah, attacked him, and killed him; he reigned in place of him, in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.
text_cn: 乌齐雅的儿子约堂二十年，厄拉的儿子曷舍亚结党反叛勒玛里雅的儿子培卡黑，杀了他，篡位为王。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, are written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
text_cn: 培卡黑其余的事迹，他行的一切，都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: In the second year of King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel, King Jotham son of Uzziah of Judah began to reign.
text_cn: 以色列王勒玛里雅的儿子培卡黑二年，乌齐雅的儿子约堂登极为犹大王。

text_en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
text_cn: 他登极时二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王凡十六年；他的母亲名叫耶鲁沙，是匝多克的女儿。

text_en: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done.
text_cn: 约堂行了上主视为正义的事，完全像他父亲乌齐雅所行的一样，

text_en: Nevertheless the high places were not removed; the people still sacrificed and made offerings on the high places. He built the upper gate of the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 只是高丘仍没有废除，人民仍在高丘上焚香献祭；他建筑了上主圣殿的北门。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?
text_cn: 约堂其余的事迹，他行的一切，都记载在《犹大列王实录》上。

text_en: In those days the Lord began to send King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.
text_cn: 那时，上主已开始派阿兰王勒斤和勒玛里雅的儿子培卡黑来攻打犹大。

text_en: Jotham slept with his ancestors, and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David, his ancestor; his son Ahaz succeeded him.
text_cn: 约堂与祖先同眠，与祖先同葬在他祖先达味城内；他的儿子阿哈次继位为王。
